caption: The drawing features a large urn-shaped vessel prominently at the center, rendered with shades of gray and faint blue, and showing surface cracks. The vessel has a wide, rounded body tapering at the bottom and top, sitting on a circular base with a spout protruding from its lower side, which is attached to a dark-colored faucet with a handle. A ring handle is visible on the vessel’s right side. The lid of the vessel is dome-shaped with layered trim and terminated by a small knob at the top. In addition to the central vessel, there are two smaller sketch outlines on the upper left and lower right corners, both depicting simplified versions of the same urn with either minimal or no detailing and both including the lid’s knob and the wide base. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with a few scattered brownish spots.
title: Porcelain Lavabo
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
